title: Senior Manager - DPDPA
description:
Serve as the main expert and first point of contact for all DPDPA (Digital Personal Data Protection Act) compliance matters.
 



 •
 



 Develop and maintain policies and processes to ensure ongoing DPDPA compliance throughout the organization.
 



 •
 



 Lead the creation, implementation, and continuous improvement of data governance frameworks that ensure accountability and regulatory alignment.
 



 •
 



 Oversee enterprise\-wide data classification initiatives to identify and categorize personal and sensitive data according to DPDPA and insurance sector guidelines.
 



 •
 



 Define security controls such as encryption, access management, retention, and secure data sharing for each category of data.
 



 •
 



 Manage all stages of the data lifecycle: collection, secure storage, use, sharing, archiving, and deletion—ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements.
 



 •
 



 Conduct risk assessments and data protection impact assessments; ensure organizational engagement with relevant regulators.
 



 •
 



 Lead and deliver cross\-functional projects on DPDPA, data governance, classification, and lifecycle management.
 



 •
 



 Provide training and foster awareness on data privacy, governance, and compliance best practices across the organization.
